_comment: Declarative source list for download.sh. Licenses are read from each dataset card at download time and written to raw/SOURCES.json; license_allowlist makes the downloader refuse anything we are not allowed to train on. 'candidates' are tried in order until min_total_bytes is reached; every attempt (including failures and license refusals) is logged to raw/DOWNLOAD_LOG.json.

sources.name: wikipedia_hi
sources.notes: Hindi Wikipedia, cleaned articles (parquet). Dataset card lists CC-BY-SA-3.0 and GFDL; attribution required.

sources.name: sangraha_verified_hin
sources.notes: AI4Bharat Sangraha, human-verified Hindi (web, PDF, speech transcripts).
